description: Get the status and output download URL of a video upscale task via GET https://videoupscaler.co/api/v1/tasks/{id}. Status is queued, processing, completed (output_url holds the MP4 download link), or failed (credits refunded). Set wait (up to 45 seconds) to long-poll until the task finishes.

id.description: The task ID returned by upscale_video.

wait.description: Optional seconds (0-45) to wait on the server for the task to complete before returning.

name: get_upscale_task
